```artifact
Feature: Doctor Management

  Scenario: Add a new Doctor
    Given a new Doctor with name "John Doe", age 30, sex "Male", qualification "MBBS", experience 5, speciality "Cardiology"
    When the Doctor is added
    Then the Doctor is saved with unique ID
    And the Doctor's details are displayed

  Scenario: View and Update Doctor Details
    Given a Doctor with ID 1 and name "John Doe", age 30, sex "Male", qualification "MBBS", experience 5, speciality "Cardiology"
    When the Doctor's details are viewed
    Then the Doctor's details are displayed
    And the speciality is not updated

  Scenario: Delete Doctor Details
    Given a Doctor with ID 1 and no pending Patient Consultation Requests
    When the Doctor is deleted
    Then the Doctor's details are deleted

  Scenario: Add a new Chemist
    Given a new Chemist with name "Chemist 1", pincode "123456", address "Address 1"
    When the Chemist is added
    Then the Chemist is saved with unique ID
    And the Chemist's details are displayed

  Scenario: Add a new Lab
    Given a new Lab with name "Lab 1", pincode "123456", address "Address 1"
    When the Lab is added
    Then the Lab is saved with unique ID
    And the Lab's details are displayed

  Scenario: View and Update Chemist/Lab Details
    Given a Chemist with ID 1 and name "Chemist 1", pincode "123456", address "Address 1"
    When the Chemist's details are viewed
    Then the Chemist's details are displayed
    And the pincode is not updated

  Scenario: Delete Chemist/Lab Details
    Given a Chemist with ID 1 and no pending Prescriptions
    When the Chemist is deleted
    Then the Chemist's details are deleted

  Scenario Outline: Add multiple Doctors with same speciality
    Given a new Doctor with name "<name>", age "<age>", sex "<sex>", qualification "<qualification>", experience "<experience>", speciality "<speciality>"
    When the Doctor is added
    Then the Doctor is saved with unique ID
    And the Doctor's details are displayed

  Examples:
    | name | age | sex | qualification | experience | speciality |
    | John | 30  | Male | MBBS          | 5          | Cardiology |
    | Jane | 25  | Female| MBBS          | 3          | Cardiology |

  Scenario Outline: Add multiple Chemists with same pincode
    Given a new Chemist with name "<name>", pincode "<pincode>", address "<address>"
    When the Chemist is added
    Then the Chemist is saved with unique ID
    And the Chemist's details are displayed

  Examples:
    | name | pincode | address |
    | Chemist 1 | 123456 | Address 1 |
    | Chemist 2 | 123456 | Address 2 |

  Scenario Outline: Add multiple Labs with same pincode
    Given a new Lab with name "<name>", pincode "<pincode>", address "<address>"
    When the Lab is added
    Then the Lab is saved with unique ID
    And the Lab's details are displayed

  Examples:
    | name | pincode | address |
    | Lab 1 | 123456 | Address 1 |
    | Lab 2 | 123456 | Address 2 |
```
